purpose: Determine whether the qualitative private-demand/investment node can be mapped into an exact inflationary-pressure state without collapsing demand-pull, supply, external-price, tax/administered-price, wage/profit and expectations channels into one behavioural equation.

ecb_transmission.finding: Consumption and investment affect aggregate demand; upward price pressure is likely when demand exceeds supply, but transmission to the price level is subject to long, variable and uncertain lags.
ecb_transmission.implication: The qualitative positive demand-to-price path is economically coherent but is not a one-to-one identity or an exact integrated equation.

ecb_inflation_drivers.finding: Inflation outcomes can be dominated by supply shocks such as energy, while demand-side factors can be minor or material depending on episode and state.
ecb_inflation_drivers.implication: Observed inflation cannot be attributed to private demand without a multi-driver identification design.

retained_HICP_boundary.concept: Romania all-items HICP ECOICOP v2 TOTAL, monthly, 2025=100
retained_HICP_boundary.interpretation: HICP is an observed inflation outcome used in a separate candidate-family evidence path. Its availability does not define the Dynamic Core inflationary_pressure node or justify a new core reference-mode extension.

retained_FX_selection.interpretation: Even the separately preregistered FX-inflation candidate failed incremental predictive gates before holdout; no inflation behavioural form is admitted.

structural_interpretation.private_demand_and_investment_role: Unresolved expenditure-side node representing parts of domestic demand, not an observed output gap or excess-demand measure.
structural_interpretation.inflationary_pressure_role: Qualitative umbrella for upward/downward price pressure arising from demand relative to supply together with external-price, cost, tax/administered-price, expectation and other channels.
structural_interpretation.HICP_role: Observed inflation outcome available for diagnostics/candidate-family empirical analysis, not automatically the exact state variable for this feedback node.

inflationary_pressure.observed_inflation_source: Romania HICP TOTAL retained by fx-inflation evidence path
